title: Solar aberration converts arcseconds to degrees incorrectly
description:
indigocat_sun.c:50: aberration constant 20.4898 arcseconds is divided by 360*60*60 before subtracting from sol.L in degrees. That makes correction 360 times too small (approximately 20 arcseconds lost near 1 AU). Solar accessor consumes this result. Next: Convert arcseconds to degrees with 60*60 only; verify degree/radian/arcsecond units and a known reference epoch.
